[Trigger: Initiative & Self: Not Acted] You immediately deal 【STR Base Value】 points of direct damage to "Target: Single / Range: 2Sq". If the target is not rendered [Incapacitated] or [Dead] by this damage, you become [Used Up] and receive [Pursuit: 20]. 1 Scenario allows [SR] times of "Kung Fu Action" you have acquired. Lightweight Gauntlet A gauntlet modeled after a dragon's claw, granting its wearer the agility of the dragon. The equipped character can dart around the battlefield with the recoil of their attacks, performing swift and seemingly impossible movements.
